description: Canvas swapchain configure capabilities: the one source that TS buildCanvasConfigureOptions() and the WASM path (JS_CreateSurfaceFromCanvas, JS_ProbeCanvasCopySrc, ConfigureSurface() in device.cpp) both read. TS imports this JSON; C++ includes wasm_renderer/canvas_configure.h, generated from it by `npm run gen:canvas-configure` (verify:device-policy fails when the header is stale or device.cpp hardcodes a contracted value). WASM keeps BOTH configures: JS (opaque + usage) then C++ (width/height + Fifo). Format is always navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat(). colorSpace/toneMapping defaults are the browser defaults and are not written explicitly on the default path. Each optIn entry is one capability; its `backends` lists the renderers that implement it, and the WASM configure may only touch keys of capabilities that list "wasm". `requires` names a capability that must also be on.

copySrc.note: Boot probe tries RENDER_ATTACHMENT|COPY_SRC inside a validation error scope, records the result, then restores render-only. Capture code reconfigures with copySrc only when the flag is true, and restores render-only when the take ends. Both backends: TS probeCanvasCopySrc (window.webgpuProbe.canvasCopySrc) and C++ JS_ProbeCanvasCopySrc (window.webgpuProbe with backend: wasm). No second GPUDevice.

displayP3.note: Never requested at boot by default. Enabled by ?display_p3=1 (wins) or the persisted Render quality toggle (localStorage storageKey). Fail-soft to srgb when the browser rejects it or getConfiguration() reports a different colorSpace.

extendedToneMapping.note: Only behind the display-p3 opt-in and only on an HDR display.

hdrCanvas.note: v4 (#1512): extended tone mapping only changes anything on a float16 swapchain, so when it is negotiated the canvas is configured as rgba16float (display-p3) and the present pipelines are re-specialised to that format. The HDR present scales scene linear light by paperWhiteNits / sdrReferenceNits and rolls values above 1.0 off towards peakNits / sdrReferenceNits instead of clamping (setHdrPresent). A cue crossfade presents through the SDR mix for its duration. window.webgpuProbe.canvasFormat reports the applied format.

storagePresent.note: v4 (#1512): with the bgra8unorm-storage feature and a bgra8unorm canvas, the swapchain also takes STORAGE_BINDING and the present is one compute pass writing it directly; the render-pass blit is skipped (it still runs while a cue crossfade mixes the hold). Probed fail-soft at boot inside a validation scope; ?storage_present=0 keeps the render pass; ?canvas_format=bgra8unorm forces the format where the preferred one is rgba8unorm (Linux / Android).

copySrc.note: Probe runs once in CreateDevice() between wgpuDevicePushErrorScope(Validation) and wgpuDevicePopErrorScope, then ConfigureSurface() restores render-only. ConfigureSurface() adds the opt-in bits only when canvasCopySrc_ is set, and only SetCanvasCopySrc() assigns it. colorSpace/toneMapping stay TS-only (optIn.displayP3 / extendedToneMapping backends).
